_note: NewsReacts (src/world/news_reacts.gd): after every battle the Doctrine news desk spins it onto the ticker and the living screens. Keys: win, loss, win:<mission_id>, loss:<mission_id>, boss_down, flawless, close_call, veil (an intercepted Veil feed, sometimes). Tokens: {place} {fallen} {crew} {mvp} {boss} {turns} {lie} (a confident wrong number).
win: {place}: 'scheduled maintenance' concludes ahead of schedule. Ministry thanks residents for not looking.
Unrest at {place} resolved by an unregistered labor collective. Ministry will register them shortly.
{fallen} Doctrine wardens reassigned to 'quiet duty' after an incident at {place}. Families are proud.
Doctrine forces achieve total victory at {place}. Footage unavailable for reasons of victory.
OFFICIAL: There was no fight at {place}. The noise was weather. The weather has been disciplined.
{place} reopens tomorrow. Please disregard the scorch marks; they are a mural.
loss: Terrorist cell routed at {place}. Doctrine casualties: zero. Again. As always.
{place} secured by heroic wardens. The {crew} intruders 'went home to think about it.'
VICTORY at {place}! Citizens are reminded that the Doctrine has never lost. Not once. Stop asking.
Cantorate sermon tonight: 'On Knowing When to Stay In Your Bar.' Attendance mandatory near {place}.
win:m01_the_brew_plan: SUPPLY WORKS: Loading dock briefly 'self-unloaded.' Ministry blames gravity, opens inquiry into gravity.
win:m02_shift_change: GUTTER DISTRICT: Shift change goes 'smoothly.' Foreman's whereabouts: a matter of personal faith.
win:relay_district: RELAY DISTRICT: Broadcast interruption was a test of the emergency broadcast system. You passed. Probably.
boss_down: {boss} on extended leave. Ministry: 'They were tired. We are all very tired.'
{boss} promoted to a position with no address. Congratulations are not necessary.
Obituary section discontinued for efficiency. Unrelated: {boss} is fine.
flawless: Doctrine analysts confirm the {place} incident took '{lie} minutes.' It took less. They are furious.
Witnesses at {place} describe 'a very good bar crew.' Witnesses are being re-educated about adjectives.
close_call: {place}: 'The enemy nearly won,' admits warden, briefly, before being corrected.
Ambulance drones report a quiet night near {place}. They were lying. They have been told to lie.
mvp: WANTED for questioning: '{mvp}', or someone who looks like them. Reward: {lie} Soul Coins. Do not approach.
Rumor desk: a figure called '{mvp}' was seen leaving {place}. Rumor desk has been dissolved.
veil: INTERCEPTED VEIL FEED: 'Doctrine embarrassed at {place},' says Kade Halloway. Veil also embarrassed, somehow.
INTERCEPTED VEIL FEED: Kade Halloway calls {place} 'a regrettable lapse in mutual stability.' Interesting choice of words.
